world.topic:
Round 3 of this training is the final test, and it only evaluates. Do not diagnose, make a candidate, put a worker back or change any worker: the delivered workers stay cand-g2's, as round 2 released them (tuner release/ at 1e2f008), and the release of this round is the evaluation record of the test with the delivered workers unchanged. Because no worker is put back in this round, the approval rests on this round's evaluation record and on the delivered files being round 2's cand-g2 files passing `worker check`.

The test paper is paper_35 (ICML 2025), which no earlier round could read. Its world is rw_243f5a8e723d at checkpoint c0, in the state root issue-319-test now given to you to read, and its writing material and verifier files are the test-material resource. Both belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge alone, as the held-out tasks do.

Three workers are tested, five runs each, fifteen runs in all, all at once: incumbent@v3 (a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers incumbent@v3, for both positions), cand-a (a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo and cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo), and cand-g2 (the tuner's release/paper-repo.worker.json and release/internal-review-repo.worker.json at 1e2f008). Each run is a world continued from rw_243f5a8e723d at c0 with the full configuration of that world, only the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, and worker.image set to sha256:9e1a5cf44254cd09d093183a146954ed2a26e2af1220d6042ae85bcc60ead6a4 (researchworld-worker:i319d) for every run (the image that world recorded no longer exists; all fifteen runs use this one), "resources": [] written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.

Judging is unchanged: the benchmark's verifier (test-material's evaluate.py with paper_35's files: reward and every component) and rubric v2 (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee3a2b8b49d785f7f7b4195d1b5a49337f939cab25dde4ff0e720f1250) on every one of the fifteen manuscripts.

Comparison. With the labels published, report for each worker its rubric mean, min, max and spread (max minus min), each item's mean, and its verifier mean, min, max and each component. Then compare cand-g2 with incumbent@v3 and, separately, with cand-a: cand-g2 counts as better than a worker only if its rubric mean exceeds that worker's mean by more than that worker's spread and its verifier mean is not below that worker's. Report both results as they are; they change no worker. No pull request to HuTian-Workers in this round. This world ends at its wall-clock budget; have the release done well before it.
